entries.title: The Halls of Lightning
body: The eastern wing of Ulduar, where the treacherous keeper Loken mass-produces iron vrykul for his dark master's plans and directs his forces from his throne, guarded by storm and fire elementals and his mightiest commanders.

entries.title: The Unyielding Garrison
body: The entrance of the Halls, held by the iron vrykul under their general.

entries.title: Volkhan's Anvil
body: A forge where a fire giant beats out golems on his anvil for Loken's army.

entries.title: The Thundering Overlook
body: The approach to Loken's inner sanctum, guarded by a lightning revenant.

entries.title: The Terrestrial Watchtower
body: Loken's inner sanctum and throne, where he made his last stand.

entries.title: General Bjarngrim
body: An iron vrykul warrior who commands the garrison at the entrance to the Halls.

entries.title: Volkhan
body: A fire giant made by Loken. With his brother Ignis, he saw the peaks around Ulduar as land ripe for conquest; they took the Winterskorn vrykul by force and forged their weapons and armour for a war against the other titan-forged.

entries.title: Ionar
body: A lightning revenant who guards the way to his master's sanctum.

entries.title: Loken
body: One of the keepers the titans set to watch over Azeroth. The Old God imprisoned beneath Ulduar corrupted him. His first killing, of his brother Thorim's wife Sif, was an accident, but every effort to hide it, and then to hide the hiding, spiralled further out of control. In the end most of the other keepers were dead or helpless, and Loken ruled Ulduar.
Desperate that the titans never learn what he had done, he cut Ulduar off from their watcher, Algalon. Only Loken's own death would call Algalon to Azeroth.
